title: luxon: add a decades unit to Duration, DateTime math and diff
prompt: This is a copy of Luxon 3.5.0 (src/, ES modules). Add `decades` (1 decade = 10 years) as a unit, wired in the same way `quarters` is. Required behaviour: `Duration.fromObject({ decades: 2 })` works, with a `decades` getter and the singular `decade` accepted by `Duration.normalizeUnit`; `as`/`shiftTo` convert between decades and every other unit in both the casual and the longterm conversion accuracy (e.g. `{years: 25}.shiftTo('decades','years')` is `{decades: 2, years: 5}`, one decade is 3650 casual days); `toISO()` folds decades into the years designator (`P20Y`, and `years: 3, decades: 1` gives `P13Y`); `DateTime#plus/minus` accept decades (clamping the day of month like years do, fractional decades included); and `DateTime#diff(other, 'decades')` works, also combined with finer units such as `['decades','years']`. Existing units must behave as before.
